decisions.reason: The burner component builds directly on the firm's core radiant-heater know-how. It is only a supporting part, but its low visibility does not signal weakness, and it fits easily within existing engineering and service capabilities.

The firm presents this electric infrared panel line as a flagship, it has its own page and several models, and it extends the firm's established infrared expertise toward electrification, where in-house R&D can keep improving it.

The halogen infrared heater sits close to the firm's established infrared knowledge and has its own page. It is a niche product but cheap to maintain within the broad range, so there is no early evidence that justifies dropping it.

This multi-model industrial electric hall heater line sits squarely in the firm's core market of large halls, where its accumulated knowledge and field-service network let it interpret results and refine the product.

The hydrogen-ready dark infrared series is a strategic flagship with a documented real-world deployment. It builds on core gas-radiant expertise and matches the firm's low-carbon direction, so continued R&D investment is very likely.
